test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_arrays_of_objects_src (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_arrays_of_objects_src SELECT '{"a":' || toString(number) || ',"b' || toString(number % 7) || '":[{"k":"k' || toString(number % 50) || '","v":' || toString(number % 1000) || '}]' || ',"c' || toString(number % 5) || '":[{"x":1,"y":"y' || toString(number % 13) || '"},{"x":2,"z":[1,2]}]' || ',"d' || toString(number % 3) || '":["t' || toString(number % 300) || '"]}' FROM numbers(300000)
test.query: SELECT s::JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 1) FROM json_arrays_of_objects_src FORMAT Null
